items.claim: Elise Reed has never lost by decision and all of her losses have been finishes.
items.quote: Reed has never lost by decision. All of her losses, she has been finished.

items.claim: Chanel Dyier has an advantage in height, reach, and youth over Elise Reed.
items.quote: I have an athletic striker with knockouts, 25 years old, taller, little bit of a reach advantage versus Elise Reed

items.claim: Wes Schultz previously defeated Jackson McVey via a quick submission in an amateur bout.
items.quote: As young amateurs, these two faced off in the LFA and Wes Schultz got a 40 second submission.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has a weakness in grappling, having suffered submission losses to Zack Ree and Bruno Ferrer.
items.quote: Jackson McVeyy's big weakness seems to be grappling. He has a submission loss to kickboxer Zack Ree. He has a submission loss to judo but really heavy-handed Bruno Ferrer.
